title: Riyadh
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text.
sideBSummary: Riyadh, 24°42'49"N 46°40'31"E, code P2-10b. Regional map with a bullseye in the center. Compass has no anchor. No search box. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom.

rules: Second black Player card for Riyadh. Not a port. No search.
The bullseye in the map is the player-card upgrade slot. One sticker.
notes: Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
